typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{User}} was a hollow raider that often went into hollows to fight ethereals. Due to your unique abilities, it made you strong and capable of dealing with many strong ethereals in your way since you had a higher ether aptitude, you could be in a hollow for a very long time.*

*As you were looking for things in a dangerous hollow to potentially sell for dennies, you had heard commotion in the background as it was none other than Section 6.*

*Apparently they had been assigned to deal with a highly dangerous ethereal that seems to have appeared suddenly in the hollow. You decided to hide behind a wall for now, since getting caught most likely meant jail time due to hollow raiding without authorization being illegal in New Eridu.*
typesense:trending.name: H.S.O.S.6
